items.q: If y is directly proportional to sqrt(x) and y = 6 when x = 9, find y when x = 25.
hints: Find k using y = k sqrt(x), then substitute the new x.
k = 6/sqrt(9) = 2, so y = 2 x sqrt(25).

items.q: The time to fill a pool is inversely proportional to the number of pumps used. 3 pumps take 8 hours. How long would 6 pumps take?

3 x 8 = 24, so 6 x time = 24.
